notes: S3 mode only. A link that fetches the file from the bucket, named and typed as with /content; it answers Range. Fetch it exactly as it is, without the key or any other header but User-Agent: anyone who has it gets the file until expires_at, about 12 hours, even if the file is deleted meanwhile. The same people may ask as for /content: 404 not_found for a file the caller doesn't see.
